heading_en: Notification Before the Application Date Concerning the Boundary Between the Banking Book and the Trading Book
summary_ja: バンキング勘定とトレーディング勘定の境界に係る届出書を適用日前に提出でき、適用日に提出されたものとみなす。
summary_en: The boundary notification between the banking book and the trading book may be submitted before the Application Date and is deemed submitted on that date.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may, even before the Application Date, in accordance with Article 11-14 of the New Public Notice, submit the notification concerning the boundary between the banking book and the trading book. In this case, that notification is deemed to have been submitted on the Application Date pursuant to that Article.
